programs.title: Last Week Tonight With John Oliver 13
programs.desc: Another season of a show full of irony and sarcasm, hosted by John Oliver.In each episode, the host summarizes the events from the world of politics from the last week.

programs.title: Druk
programs.desc: Denmark.Martin, Tommy, Peter and Nikolaj work as middle school teachers.They are burnt out and everyday life is taking its toll on them.During Nikolaj's birthday party, the men discuss the theory that humans are born with an alcohol deficit.Its small dose - only half a per mille in the blood - is supposed to increase their overall satisfaction.They decide to test it themselves and be excited every day.They quickly notice the positive effects - their family relationships improve, and they start to do better at work.Martin is finally able to communicate with his wife Anika and children, and the students finally listen to him with interest.Over time, however, it turns out that the initial dose is no longer enough for my friends and they start increasing it.They find that everything has its price.

programs.title: Living
programs.desc: London, 1953. Rodney Williams (Bill Nighy) has been doing the same boring bureaucratic job for years.A lonely man feels that his life has been meaningless for a long time.One day he learns from the doctor that he has been diagnosed with incurable cancer.Desperate, he goes to a seaside town to commit suicide.However, he changes his mind and spends the night wandering around bars with a writer he meets there, Sutherland (Tom Burke).Back in London, Williams doesn't go to the office.He runs into Margaret Harris (Aimee Lou Wood), a much younger and energetic woman who once worked in his department.He becomes friends with her and she infects him with her enthusiasm.When the man's condition worsens, he decides to do something important.With the help of Peter Wakeling (Alex Sharp), a young idealist from his office, he wants to build a playground, the construction of which he himself had previously blocked.A remake of "The Brand of Death", a drama by Akira Kurosawa, inspired by Leo Tolstoy's short story "The Death of Ivan Ilyich".

programs.title: The Other Guys
programs.desc: Hot-tempered New York detective Terry Hoitz (Mark Wahlberg) dreams of his name going down in police history.Unfortunately, he is punitively delegated to office work.His dim-witted partner Allen Gamble (Will Ferrell) is not keen on catching criminals and would rather spend his days behind a desk.As a result, those with completely opposite characters do not like each other.However, both of them share a feeling of inferiority because they are still in the shadow of the local police celebrities: P.K.Highsmith (Samuel L. Jackson) and Christopher Danson (Dwayne Johnson).The opportunity to take their place comes sooner than they might expect.When the famous duo is killed in action, Terry and Allen face the opportunity of a lifetime.They are on the trail of a scandal involving multimillionaire David Ershon (Steve Coogan).If they manage to find evidence of a crime and catch the culprits, they will gain recognition and decorations.However, if they fail, they will face professional degradation.

programs.title: River Wild
programs.desc: Idaho.Doctor Joey (Leighton Meester) goes to meet Brother Gray (Taran Killam), who is organizing a rafting trip on the Salmon River.There he meets his long-time friend Trevor (Adam Brody), who is on parole, and two young women.Initially, the rafting takes place in a relaxed atmosphere.Everything changes on their first night together, when the kayakers set up camp.One of the young women suffers serious injuries.The circumstances of the incident are unclear, and the injured party herself claims that she was the victim of an attack.The incident disturbs the peace of Joey and the other participants of the expedition.However, it turns out that this is only the beginning of the problems.

programs.title: 4 from there
programs.desc: Another installment of the adventures of people living in a town straight from a nightmare.It is a terrifying place that traps anyone who crosses its borders.Desperate residents fight to stay alive.

programs.title: House of the Dragon 2
programs.desc: The second series of the production, the events of which precede the action of "Game of Thrones".After the death of Lucerys Velaryon, the son of Queen Rhaenyra Targaryen (Emma D'Arcy), which was caused by his cousin, Aemond Targaryen (Ewan Mitchell), Westeros finds itself on the brink of a bloody civil war.The Green Council supporting King Aegon (Tom Glynn-Carney) and Queen Rhaenyra's Black Council are fighting for influence.Each side claims the Iron Throne.The dynamic development of events also affects the attitude of Rhaenyra's husband, Daemon (Matt Smith), in life.A man who spends a lot of time in Harrenhal Castle, away from his wife, changes a lot.In addition, the demons of his past begin to haunt him.

programs.title: Alien: Romulus
programs.desc: The year 2142. The Jackson's Star mining colony was established on the distant planet LV-410.The workers include orphaned Rain (Cailee Spaeny) and Andy (David Jonsson), a robot reprogrammed by her father.The girl wants to escape to a better world, but her forced labor contract is extended by the corporation.Together with his brother android, he joins the rebels who discovered that there is an abandoned research station hovering over the planet.The fugitives get aboard and discover cryogenic chambers, thanks to which they can make a long interplanetary journey.However, they do not know that there is also a bloodthirsty beast on the ship that they will have to face.A continuation of the famous SF horror series, well received by critics and viewers.The action takes place between the events of "Alien - 8th Passenger of the Nostromo" by Ridley Scott and "Alien - The Decisive Engagement" by James Cameron.

programs.title: Abigail
programs.desc: A group of criminals breaks into a perfectly secured mansion.Their goal is to kidnap twelve-year-old ballerina Abigail (Alisha Weir).The bandits transport a hostage, for whom a ransom of $50 million has been set, to Lambert (Giancarlo Esposito).She is to spend the night in an isolated residence.The kidnappers guarding her disappear one by one.The truth about who they were locked up with finally comes to light.The inconspicuous-looking victim is not as defenseless as it may seem.An unusual variation on the vampire motif.

programs.title: 28 Years Later
programs.desc: There is still a bloody fight for survival on Earth.The survivors of the epidemic protect themselves from zombies in a closely guarded stronghold on the island.The world forces twelve-year-old Spike (Alfie Williams), the son of Jamie (Aaron Taylor-Johnson) and Isla (Jodie Comer), to grow up in inhumane conditions.He will be hunting for the infected on the mainland under his father's supervision.Despite his young age, the boy must be prepared for a ruthless fight to the death.The expedition shows him the terrible consequences of being infected with a mysterious virus.It soon comes to light that not only the undead have mutated, but also those who survived.The trail leads to the doctor, Dr. Kelson (Ralph Fiennes)... The last part of the trilogy after "28 Days Later" and "28 Weeks Later" by Danny Boyle and Alex Garland, showing a world overrun by zombies.

programs.title: Apolonia, Apolonia
programs.desc: A painting made over several years, showing the personal and artistic development of Apolonia Sokol, a young generation painter with Polish roots.Her works have been shown in France and the USA.

programs.title: Legend of the Boneknapper Dragon
programs.desc: Gobber is convinced that the legendary dragon Gnatochrup is behind the burning of his house.When none of the neighbors want to believe in the existence of the beast, the old Viking decides to hunt the dragon that is stalking him.He is joined by Hiccup and friends to ensure Gobber's safe return.During the sea journey, they listen to more and more unbelievable stories about the rivalry between a Viking and a monster.Eventually, the travelers crash on Dragon Island, where they learn the truth about Gnatochrup.The animation is a continuation of the film "How to Train Your Dragon".In the Polish language version, the characters were voiced by, among others:Tomasz Traczyński, Mateusz Narloch, Grzegorz Drojewski and Julia Kamińska.
